info.name: Fayeza - Banners Blogs Shopping Orders Delivery
info.description:
Make Me Pretty API tests for Fayeza's modules: banners, blogs, cart and wishlist, orders (customer and admin) and delivery.

Before running: open the Variables tab of this collection and set the CURRENT value of adminEmail and adminPassword (your admin account from backend/.env). Then run the folders in order, or use Run collection. Every run creates its own fresh test users, so it can be repeated.

item.name: 0 Setup (run first)

exec: if (String(pm.collectionVariables.get("adminEmail")).startsWith("PUT_")) { throw new Error("First open the collection Variables tab and set adminEmail and adminPassword (Current value)."); }

item.description: Creates the admin session, two customers, a delivery partner and two products. Every later folder depends on this one.

exec: const iA = list.findIndex(b => b.title === "Fayeza Slide A " + run);
const iB = list.findIndex(b => b.title === "Fayeza Slide B " + run);
pm.test("Both test banners are in the list", () => { pm.expect(iA).to.be.above(-1); pm.expect(iB).to.be.above(-1); });
pm.test("Slide B is before Slide A", () => pm.expect(iB).to.be.below(iA));
